MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small, quick-setting Gorilla epoxy fits the occasional fixing jobs behind my tape and adhesive purchases.",
    "Heat shrink tubing complements my crimp connectors by protecting wire connections, while VELCRO offers a removable fastening option alongside my tapes and clamps."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Fluorescent gaffer tape serves a marking purpose I do not currently have; having bought utility tape does not make every kind of tape useful to me.",
    "Layout fluid, particular nut sizes, and a temperature gun require specific jobs I have not indicated. The large steel-repair epoxy pack also exceeds what I would choose for occasional adhesive repairs.",
    "My portion cups do not establish a need for pipettes; holding small portions and transferring liquids are different tasks."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My practical repair purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when its purpose is quite specialized.",
    "Similar materials or product names seem to count too much when the intended use, quantity, or fastening method differs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I need a clear use for an item before choosing it. A tool being broadly useful is not enough to make it a current purchase.",
    "Complementing something I already use matters: tubing helps finish electrical connections, whereas a second similar tubing assortment would duplicate the one I would choose.",
    "Quantity and repair purpose matter together. A small general repair adhesive appeals more right now than a large pack focused on steel repairs."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my practical repair interests but sometimes stretch them into specialized supplies without a clear task or suitable quantity."
}
